headline: Central Front Shifts as Colonials Gain Ground
war_summary: Since the 06:00 edition the central corridor has moved modestly toward the Wardens. In Dead Lands the Warden hold has edged from a 6‑5 split to 7‑4, while Drowned Vale (12‑0), Farranac Coast (9‑2) and Endless Shore (9‑1) remain firmly Colonial. Clahstra is now wholly Colonial, Linn Mercy stays an all‑Warden bastion, and Kingscage continues to lean Colonial seven to one; the Fingers stay contested at three Warden to four Colonial. The peripheral arcs are unchanged: Colonials hold the western‑southern belt from Acrithia through Umbral Wildwood, and Wardens retain the northern‑eastern stretch from Basin Sionnach to the Weathered Expanse. Base turnover in the past day was heaviest on Endless Shore (42 changes), Drowned Vale (31), Farranac Coast (18), Dead Lands (17), Palantine Berm (14) and Linn Mercy (13). Casualty rates have accelerated in the most recent hour on the three hottest fronts — both factions rising on Farranac Coast, Colonial losses accelerating on Endless Shore, and Warden losses accelerating on Dead Lands — while Drowned Vale shows a lull. Enlistments are accelerating on Dead Lands and Farranac Coast, cooling on Drowned Vale and Endless Shore, signalling fresh reinforcements at the busiest sectors.
